Matches user-agent specific rules in robots.txt

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"respect_robots_txt\":true,\"user_agent\":\"CrawlbergBot\"}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.isAllowed())
```
